bookmarklet.title: Add from a job ad
bookmarklet.intro: A bookmarklet sends the link here, and the job title and company too when the page states them. You check and save yourself.
bookmarklet.platsbanken: On Platsbanken the bookmark asks Arbetsförmedlingen’s open job API (JobTech) for the ad you are looking at, and brings the company, job title, occupation and last application date. That one request is made from the Platsbanken page, and only there. This app itself still makes no network requests. On LinkedIn and some other sites only the link comes along.
bookmarklet.version: Bookmark version {version}. A bookmark you made earlier keeps working, but make it again to get the newest version.
bookmarklet.unavailable: A bookmarklet can only be made when the app is opened from a web address (http or https).
bookmarklet.step1: Show the bookmarks bar (Ctrl+Shift+B in Chrome, Edge and Firefox; in Safari: View ▸ Show Favorites Bar).
bookmarklet.step2: Drag the button below to the bookmarks bar.
bookmarklet.step3: Click the bookmark while you are on a job ad.
bookmarklet.dragNotClick: Drag the button to the bookmarks bar. Clicking it here does nothing.
bookmarklet.byHand: Make the bookmark by hand: add a new bookmark (Ctrl+D), choose Edit or More, and paste the code as its address or URL. This is also the way if you use the keyboard.
bookmarklet.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the code below and copy it yourself.
bookmarklet.local: You are viewing this page on your own computer. A bookmark made here only works while the app runs here. Make it from the real address.
bookmarklet.limits: Some sites block bookmarklets or do not state the job details. Then it opens with the link only, or not at all. Paste the link as usual instead. If the ad sits in a box inside another page, the wrong link may come along. If the app address changes, the bookmark has to be made again.

welcome.title: A notepad for your job applications
welcome.intro: You fill in each job yourself, so you always know what you've applied for, with which CV, and when it's time to follow up. Nothing is fetched or sent automatically. There are no accounts, and everything is saved only in this browser.

step1.title: Add your CV (optional)
step1.body: Upload a PDF, so you always see which CV you sent to which job.

step2.title: Add a job you want to apply for
step2.body: Paste the link to the ad. You can add the company and role if you like.

step3.title: Mark it when you've applied
step3.body: Then the app counts the days for you and shows when it is time to follow up.

welcome.tip: Tip: download a backup now and then, so you always have a copy of your data.
